description: Pub. 925 (2025), Special $25,000 allowance example: single, $70,000 wages, $15,000 passive income from a limited partnership, $26,000 loss from rental real estate with active participation; modified AGI under $100,000. '$15,000 of your $26,000 loss' offsets the partnership income and 'the remaining $11,000' offsets wages: Form 8582 line 9 = $11,000, nothing carried over, AGI = 70,000 + 15,000 − 26,000 = $59,000.
